name: Leshy, Vine
body:
VINE LESHY
CR 5

This tangle of vines in the shape of a man walks with ease. The vines that extend from this creature seem to lengthen and undulate of their own accord.

XP 1,600
CE Small plant (leshy)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception -2

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 45 (7d8+14)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +0
Defensive Abilities evasion; Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +9 (1d4+3 plus grab)
Special Attacks constrict (1d4+3), sneak attack +2d6, verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +8)

3/day— invisibility
At-Will—tree shape (small vines only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 13, Int 12, Wis 7, Cha 15
Base Atk +5; CMB +7 (+13 grapple); CMD 20 (22 vs. grapple)
Feats Dodge, Improved Grapple, Improved Initiative, Toughness
Skills Bluff +9, Diplomacy +9, Stealth +16 (+20 Stealth in forest), Survival -2 (+2 Survival in forest); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in forests
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Suffocating Strangle (Ex)

A vine leshy’s grappled foes cannot speak, breathe, or cast spells with verbal components. Each time it succeeds at a grapple check against a creature holding its breath, the number of rounds it can hold its breath before suffocating is reduced by 1d4.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

A vine leshy can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
